summary: The PRSearchStudents module is responsible for retrieving, formatting, and filtering historical placement request data for students, staff, instructors, and supervisors. It manages which placement records are visible or editable to users based on their roles, permissions, and agency, enforcing business rules around data privacy and access. It includes support for complex business logic such as consent expiry, hour validation, multiple instructors, group placements, split placements, and placement request hierarchies.
purpose: To provide structured, permission-sensitive lists of placement requests (PRs) and placement request destinations (PRDs) associated with students, instructors, supervisors, and staff, including all necessary business rules, workflow, and validations needed to display, sort, and update placement history in an educational or agency context.

workflows.name: Student Placement Request History Search
steps: Initialize allowed locations (sites, services, destinations, sub-disciplines) based on session/user.
Call database procedure to retrieve PR history for student.
For each result: apply consent expiry masking logic, format names and dates.
Filter and format placement data according to business and privacy rules.
Update split parent hours if necessary.
Return ordered, formatted list for display.

workflows.name: Staff Placement Search
steps: Call StaffPlacementSearchHistory or StaffPlacementSearchInternal stored procedures.
For each record, check status and permissions, apply field masking as required.
Format entry for display, including details, tooltips, and click actions.

workflows.name: Supervisor/Instructor Placement Request History Search
steps: Call stored procedure with relevant parameters.
Sort and filter result list based on sort expression (date, course, site, or status).
For each entry, check permission and allowed lists.
Format data for display, including instructor information and duration formatting.

workflows.name: Placement Request Update (Student Hours)
steps: Validate PRD_ID and StudentID are positive.
Check that amended duration is not negative (unless special code -99 for not set).
If valid, update PlacementRequestStudentHours in database with new duration and notes.

business_rules: Placement details are only shown to users with permissions for the agency, site, service, destination, and sub-discipline.
Archived placement requests have special display (e.g., comments icon) and are not included in certain lists.
Students cannot see detailed PR information unless their consent is valid and request is confirmed.
Data masking for consent-expired students (names cleared if consent is expired).
Placement hour differences greater than a threshold (e.g., 8 hours) are highlighted in red.
Group and split requests are treated specially for hour calculations and display.
validations: Amended duration hours must not be less than zero (except -99 for unset).
PRD_ID and StudentID must be greater than zero for updates.
Consent status is checked and enforced for privacy.
Records outside the user's allowed location lists are hidden.
calculations: Split parent placement hours are calculated by summing children’s hours, dividing by group size.
DurationHoursFormatted and ExpectedDurationHoursFormatted fields can be conditionally highlighted or displayed based on difference and thresholds.
ASMResultsFormatted shows rank and preference count for assignment-matched placements.
conditions: If a user does not have access to a location (site, service, destination, sub-discipline), details are hidden.
If the PR is archived, comments and tooltips are shown instead of standard details.
If consent is expired, names are masked for non-system administrators.
If a placement is not confirmed, details may be hidden from students.
If placement is split or grouped, special calculation and display rules apply.
system_behavior: Retrieves and formats lists of placement requests for specific user types.
Sorts and orders results by user-defined expressions (e.g., date, status, course).
Supports click actions for viewing placement details and staff costing.
Handles consent expiry, masking fields as required.
Maintains data privacy and enforces security on sensitive information.
Updates student hours on placement requests with validation.
dependencies: Session context: agency, user type, permissions.
Stored procedures for retrieving and updating data (e.g., StudentSearchPRHistory, StaffPlacementSearchHistory, PlacementRequestStudentHoursUpdate).
Resources for localized UI strings, formatting utilities.
exceptions: Records hidden for users outside permission boundaries.
Details masked for expired consent, or non-confirmed placements for students.
Validation errors prevent updates to duration hours or student hours.
Special handling for archived placements and split/group requests.
